description: Track C — Resident view. Profile header (avatar with initials fallback + unit pill), pencil edit-profile (Name, Phone, notify opt-in) + avatar upload, two collapsible pass sections (collapsed by default) wired to #new/?edit=1 deep-links with deterministic focus, pass history labelled by issuer, overstay HOA note, and the pending-verification banner. Requirements AC-3.1..3.8; design sections 3.1-3.5. Creates migration 018_epd_feedback.sql (if not yet present) with avatar_key, notify_guest_events, pass.created_by. Depends on FEAT-005 for ctx.unitVerified/me.unitVerified (the pending-verification banner); read me.unitVerified defensively (treat missing as verified) so C builds green before E, and E completes the column/ctx/me wiring. Run C before E.
steps: Create apps/api/migrations/018_epd_feedback.sql if it does not exist. Add: app_user.avatar_key text (nullable); app_user.notify_guest_events boolean not null default true; pass.created_by uuid references app_user(id) (nullable). (FEAT-004 and FEAT-005 append their own columns to the SAME file.)

API — avatar: add POST /v1/me/avatar (defineRoute, perm 'me') in apps/api/src/routes/people.ts or auth.ts, JSON body { contentType: z.enum(['image/png','image/jpeg','image/webp']), dataBase64: z.string() }. Base64-decode dataBase64; enforce decoded size <= 2097152 bytes and a MIME/signature match else throw HttpError(400,'avatar_invalid'). Store via app.storage.put(`${ctx.tenantId}/avatars/${ctx.userId}.<ext>`, buffer) (ext from MIME); on put failure throw HttpError(503,'storage_unavailable') logged at warn. Write the key to app_user.avatar_key. Mirror the plate-crop pattern in routes/misc.ts.
API — GET /v1/me (routes/auth.ts): return avatarUrl = signUrl(app.cfg.JWT_SECRET, avatar_key, 300) when avatar_key is set else null (never the raw key). Do NOT add policy to /v1/me.

API — PATCH /v1/me/profile (routes/people.ts): add only notifyGuestEvents?: z.boolean() to the EXISTING body; keep name (<=100), phone (regex /^\+[1-9]\d{7,14}$/ nullable), locale exactly as shipped. Add one assignment notify_guest_events = coalesce($N, notify_guest_events) (nullable param, omitted => untouched).

API — gate the host party in sendPassNotification (services/passes.ts) on the host's notify_guest_events (the host row join already loads the host; add notify_guest_events to the select and skip the host party when false). Default true preserves current behavior.

API — issuedByRole: in createPass set created_by = ctx.userId. In presentPass/listPasses add issuedByRole = (created_by is not null and created_by = host_user_id) ? 'host' : (created_by is not null) ? 'staff' : 'unknown' to the RESIDENT-facing projection; never surface the staff member's name/email/id. Pin in apps/api/test/passes.test.ts.

Web — Resident.tsx profile header: circular avatar showing me.avatarUrl or initials (first letters of me.user.name else email local-part), onError -> initials. Unit pill positioned bottom-center overlapping the avatar via CSS logical props (inset-block-end, inset-inline-start:50%, transform:translateX(-50%)). Pencil <button aria-label={t('res.editProfile')}> opens an edit form capturing Name + Phone (existing fields) + a notify opt-in toggle, submitting { name, phone, notifyGuestEvents } to PATCH /v1/me/profile and (if a file is chosen) POST /v1/me/avatar; errors via role='alert' errText.

Web — two collapsible sections 'New Guest Parking Pass' and 'Previous Parking Passes' via a button-driven <Collapsible> (aria-expanded region, NOT <details>), both collapsed by default. Read useSearchParams().get('edit') first then location.hash === '#new' (edit wins when both present). #new expands the New section and moves focus: form first input when !pass; Share button when an active-pass card is shown; else the section heading (tabIndex={-1}) as guaranteed fallback. Add refs only to the heading and to controls that actually render.

Web — pass history rows show an 'issued by' label from issuedByRole ('issued by you' / 'issued by an attendant' / 'issued by host' for unknown/legacy). Overstay note: reword res.rules/res.mustLeave to state the HOA-platform wording while keeping {hours} and {amount} placeholders (fmt.money(policy.overstayCharge)); never a literal; $0.00 on an unset non-MXN tenant is intentional and must render.

Web — banner-vs-form decision (reads me.unitVerified via useApp().me): (1) me.unit == null -> existing res.noUnit/res.noUnitAdmin banner; (2) else resident && me.unitVerified === false -> pending-verification banner, hide/disable the create form; (3) else -> create form. The overstay amount still comes from GET /v1/passes/active.policy (ungated). If me.unitVerified is undefined at this point (FEAT-005 not yet merged), treat as verified so the build is green; FEAT-005 finalizes the field.

Add all new UI strings (avatar alt, editProfile, notify opt-in label, section headings, pending-verification banner, issued-by labels, reworded res.rules/res.mustLeave) to ALL seven web locale catalogs with matching ICU placeholders. Add any new CSS to styles.css using logical properties only.
acceptance_criteria: Resident screen welcomes by name, shows avatar-or-initials with a bottom-center unit pill, and a pencil opens an edit form persisting Name/Phone/notify opt-in via PATCH /v1/me/profile and an avatar via POST /v1/me/avatar.

POST /v1/me/avatar validates MIME + 2 MB decoded cap (400 avatar_invalid) and stores via app.storage; GET /v1/me returns a 5-minute signed avatarUrl, never the key; an API test covers valid + oversize + bad-MIME.
Two pass sections are collapsible and collapsed by default; ?edit=1 opens the editor (wins over #new), #new opens the New section with deterministic focus.
Pass history distinguishes host- vs attendant-issued passes via issuedByRole without exposing staff identity (API test pins it); legacy NULL rows label neutrally.
The overstay note renders the configured amount via fmt.money (never a literal), and the pending-verification banner appears only for a resident holding an unverified unit (precedence as specified).
The full verification gate passes and all new strings exist in every catalog (i18n parity green).
findings:
DONE. Full gate green (core build, typecheck, api+web+core+ui+sdk tests, check:css).

MIGRATION 018 (apps/api/migrations/018_epd_feedback.sql) — FEAT-003 CREATED the file with THREE columns; FEAT-004 and FEAT-005 must APPEND their own ALTERs below (do not create a new migration, do not reorder). Current contents:
  - app_user.avatar_key text (nullable)
  - app_user.notify_guest_events boolean not null default true
  - pass.created_by uuid references app_user(id) (nullable)
It was applied to the local worktree test DB via `pnpm migrate` (shows 'applied: 018_epd_feedback.sql'). FEAT-005's membership.unit_verified + invite column + user_memberships drop/recreate + claim_invites/accept_invite re-create + session.authorized_by (FEAT-004) go in THIS SAME file.

BANNER / VERIFICATION CONTRACT FEAT-005 MUST FINALIZE:
  - Web Me type (apps/web/src/app-context.tsx) now carries OPTIONAL `avatarUrl?: string|null` and `unitVerified?: boolean`. FEAT-005 should make `unitVerified` non-optional once GET /v1/me always returns it. Resident.tsx reads me.unitVerified DEFENSIVELY: pending banner renders ONLY when `me.roles.includes('resident') && me.unitVerified === false`; undefined/missing is treated as VERIFIED (so C builds green before E). FEAT-005 adds the real `unitVerified` to GET /v1/me (routes/auth.ts) + ctx.unitVerified (http.ts/server.ts) and gates createPass — C already consumes the field, no Resident.tsx change needed once E ships it, but re-run the resident-view.test.tsx precedence cases after E.
  - Precedence in Resident.tsx (do not reorder): (1) me.unit==null -> existing res.noUnit/res.noUnitAdmin banner; (2) resident && unitVerified===false -> res.pendingVerify banner, create form hidden; (3) else -> create form. Overstay amount still comes from GET /v1/passes/active.policy (ungated), NOT from /v1/me.

API ADDED (this FEAT):
  - GET /v1/me (routes/auth.ts): now returns `avatarUrl` = signUrl(JWT_SECRET, avatar_key, 300) or null; raw key never surfaced. No policy added to /v1/me (unchanged otherwise).
  - POST /v1/me/avatar (routes/people.ts, perm 'me'): JSON { contentType: enum(png|jpeg|webp), dataBase64 }; decoded size<=2MB + magic-byte/MIME match else HttpError(400,'avatar_invalid'); app.storage.put at `${tenantId}/avatars/${userId}.<ext>`; put failure -> HttpError(503,'storage_unavailable') logged at warn. Returns {ok:true} (HTTP 200, not 201).
  - PATCH /v1/me/profile (routes/people.ts): added ONLY notifyGuestEvents?:boolean + `notify_guest_events = coalesce($6, notify_guest_events)`. name/phone/locale handling and phone regex unchanged.
  - services/passes.ts: createPass sets created_by=ctx.userId; presentPass projects issuedByRole = created_by==null ? 'unknown' : created_by===host_user_id ? 'host' : 'staff' (host_user_id now selected via p.*; added host_user_id/created_by to PassRow type). No staff identity surfaced. sendPassNotification gates the HOST party for checked_in/checked_out on host_notify (h.notify_guest_events) !== false (default true preserves behavior).

ERROR CODES to add to web err.* catalogs if surfaced later: avatar_invalid, storage_unavailable (not added to locales this FEAT — the Resident edit form maps avatar oversize to res.avatarTooBig client-side and shows server errText otherwise).

WEB (this FEAT): Resident.tsx rewritten — profile header (Avatar: img|initials fallback via initialsOf + onError, unit pill bottom-center via inset-inline-start:50% + translateX(-50%)), pencil button (aria-label res.editProfile) toggling EditProfile (Name+Phone+notify checkbox + file input -> PATCH /v1/me/profile then POST /v1/me/avatar base64), two button-driven <Collapsible> (aria-expanded region, NOT <details>) both collapsed by default, ?edit=1 wins over #new (useSearchParams first, then window location.hash), #new focus rule (form first input when !pass; Share button when active-pass card via shareRef; else section heading tabIndex=-1). SharePass now takes optional shareRef. History rows show res.issuedBy_{host|staff|unknown}. New i18n keys in all 7 catalogs (en, es-MX, es-ES, pt-BR, fr, de, ar; NOT en-XA): res.welcomeName, res.editProfile, res.avatarAlt, res.avatarLabel, res.avatarTooBig, res.notifyGuests, res.notifyHelp, res.sectionNew, res.sectionPrevious, res.pendingVerify, res.issuedBy_host/staff/unknown, res.noHistory; reworded res.rules/res.mustLeave to HOA-platform wording keeping {hours}/{amount}/{time}. New CSS in styles.css is logical-props only (.profile-head/.avatar/.avatar-pill/.btn.icon/.row.gap/.collapsible*). Removed the old always-on PhoneCard (its editing now lives in EditProfile).

TESTS ADDED: apps/api/test/passes.test.ts — avatar valid(200)/oversize/bad-MIME + /v1/me signed URL (never key) + notify opt-out suppresses host alert + issuedByRole host/staff/unknown(legacy NULL) without staff identity leak. apps/web/test/resident-view.test.tsx — 10 cases (initials, unit pill, welcome, collapsed-by-default, pencil edit submit, ?edit=1 precedence, issued-by labels, pending banner precedence incl. missing-unitVerified-as-verified, overstay amount from policy).

NOTE: supervisor LACKS pass.own perm so cannot POST /v1/passes; the 'staff'-issued test uses the owner/admin. Autonomy decision recorded: avatar route returns {ok:true}=200 (matches plate-crop/profile convention), not created(201).
